C0645.title: Liability Determination for Employee Accidental Database Deletion During Work
C0645.summary: Lvtu.com analyzes a labor dispute case where employee Xiao Zhu accidentally deleted the company database, causing losses and prompting the company to demand full compensation. Legal analysis indicates that accidental database deletion during work constitutes an employment act, with the employer generally bearing initial liability. The employer may seek recovery from employees who acted with intent

references.title: How to bear responsibility for accidentally deleting a database _ Legal Map
